strategy.name: Smart Money Breakout Channels [AlgoAlpha]
strategy.description: Identifies periods of low volatility (consolidation channels) and trades the high-momentum breakout from these ranges using a 'Strong Close' filter to avoid wicks.

indicators.channel_top: The upper boundary of the detected consolidation range.
indicators.channel_bottom: The lower boundary of the detected consolidation range.
indicators.body_midpoint: The average of Open and Close ( (Open+Close)/2 ) used to confirm a strong breakout.

bullish: Price is breaking above the channel top
bearish: Price is breaking below the channel bottom

long: A consolidation channel has been formed
The body midpoint ( (Open+Close)/2 ) is strictly above the channel top boundary
Price action shows high momentum breaking the upper bound
short: A consolidation channel has been formed
The body midpoint ( (Open+Close)/2 ) is strictly below the channel bottom boundary
Price action shows high momentum breaking the lower bound

exit_rules: Exit when price returns inside the channel boundaries
Hard stop: 1% opposite to the breakout direction
Take profit: Target a 2:1 Reward-to-Risk ratio based on the channel height
risk_rules: Risk maximum 1% of portfolio per trade
Maximum trade size capped by MAX_TRADE_SIZE_USD in .env
Maximum trades per day capped by MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY in .env
Ignore breakouts that happen during extreme volatility spikes (avoid 'fakeouts')
notes: Strategy relies on the detection of 'Smart Money' accumulation/distribution zones. The 'Strong Close' rule is critical to avoid getting trapped by wicks.
